description: Servicio WMS (Web Map Service) Peligrosidad por Inundación is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). The Web Service Hazardousness Maps of the Areas of Significant Potential Flood Risk (ARPSI) prepared in each Demarcation by the competent authorities for water, coasts and civil protection in accordance with Article 8 of Royal Decree 903/2010 of 9 July 2010 on the assessment and management of flood risks, which transposes Directive 2007/60/EC on the ... Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS (Web Map Service) Flood Hazard" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. The listing shows 2018-01-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
